cases.purpose: Check the invalid-user diagnostic and failure status separately from successful distinct-identity transfers, and verify the existing ownership is preserved.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils chown under the same guest and locale
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status marker, normalized diagnostic, and numeric ownership.
cases.script:
/usr/bin/touch diagnostic-item
rc=0
chown no_such_user_bashos_suite_987654 diagnostic-item 2>diagnostic.err || rc=$?
printf 'status=%s err=' "$rc"
/usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' diagnostic.err | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'
printf '\n'
/usr/bin/stat -c '%u:%g' diagnostic-item
